notes.title: ServerComposer 2021.01.09 update released!
notes.content:
Welcome to the January 2022 update for ServerComposer . New functions have been added :

Room management functions:

[list]
[*]string CreateRoom(string RoomName,int RoomSeats)
[*]int JoinRoom(string RoomId,int ConnectionId,string ConnectionName)
[*]int SetRoomAtribute(string RoomId,string AtributeName,string AtributeData)
[*]string GetRoomAtribute(string RoomId,string AtributeName)
[*]int SetRoomTag(string RoomId,string TagName,string TagValue)
[*]string GetRoomTag(string RoomId,string TagName)
[*]string FindRoomToJoin(string AtributesFilter,string TagsFilter)
[*]int LeaveRoom(string RoomId,int ConnectionId)
[*]int SendMessageToRoom(string RoomId,string MessageToAll)
[*]int GetUserBySeat(string RoomId,int SeatPos)
[*]int SetUserAtribute(int ConnectionId,string AtributeName,string AtributeValue)
[*]string GetUserAtribute(int ConnectionId,string AtributeName)
[*]int SetUserTag(int ConnectionId,string TagName,string TagValue)
[*]string GetUserTag(int ConnectionId,string TagName)
[*]string GetUserRoom(int ConnectionId)
[/list]

UniqueId function:

[list]
[*]string GenerateUuid()
[/list]

Added +2 networking management functions

[list]
[*]int CloseNetworkConnection(int ConnectionId)
[*]int GetConnectedAmount()
[/list]

in a few hours functions will be inserted and updated in the official documentation.

Thanks to everyone for their patience, we are committed to making ServerComposer an innovative and useful tool to solve various problems in creating server software.

notes.title: A fully reworked version available soon!
notes.content:
We are currently working hard so that soon we will have a totally new and revamped version of Server Composer, it will never be so easy, practical and simple to create any kind of servers for any kind of software applications.

[list]
[*] We rewrite the core servers 
[*] IDE has been redesigned
[*] New server types have been added ( Http and PaS [ publish and subscribe] )
[*] Numerous features have been integrated into the Server Core
[*] There is the ability to create or import plugins made in Lua
[*] And many other news
[/list]

check out some screenshots below :

( New Server Types [ other types will come ] )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33713484/3230fd2e799fcbbe6f5e9fc6846640e527d3f519.png[/img]

( IDE redesigned )

notes.title: ServerComposer Update! Version 0.15 Released!
notes.content:
ServerComposer Version 0.15 - 2018.10.26
Today we have released a new version of ServerComposer with some new fixes. Full details of what's new in this release are listed here:
 
Socket
[list]
[*] Fixed GetMessage failing to clear the received message buffer.
[/list]
 
WebSocket
[list]
[*] Fixed GetMessage failing to clear the received message buffer.
[*] Fixed SendMessageToAll failing to clear the received message buffer.
[/list]

IDE
[list]
[*] Fixed IntelliSense dont showing on Japanese Locale .
[/list]

Lua Interpreter
[list]
[*] increased stack memory .
[*] improvement in garbage management .
[/list]

For any eventualities, sign up for the forum : https://mysocket.space/forums/sc/
